#include <iostream>
#include <string>

int main() {
    std::string input;
    std::cin >> input;
    
    input += ' ';
    
    int answer = 0;
    int count = 0;
    char prevChar = input[0];
    
    for (int i = 1; i < input.length(); i++) {
        char currentChar = input[i];
        if (currentChar != prevChar) {
            if ((count + 1) % 2 == 0) {
                answer++;
            }
            count = 0;
            prevChar = currentChar;
        } else {
            count++;
        }
    }
    
    std::cout << answer << std::endl;
    
    return 0;
}
